cohort: Low-risk pregnant women (63 vaginal delivery, 24 cesarean delivery)
finding: Hemodynamic changes during labor and delivery differ between vaginal and cesarean deliveries, with vaginal delivery showing a peak in CI during the second stage and a nadir in TPRI immediately postpartum, while cesarean delivery shows a peak in TPRI and a decline in CI within 1-hour postpartum.
mod_finding: The study compared hemodynamics during labor and delivery in women undergoing vaginal delivery versus cesarean section.
